eventDetail.scope: The conference provides a multidisciplinary forum to present and discuss advances in regenerative and intelligent technologies that drive industrial innovation, societal well-being, and environmental sustainability. Its scope includes AI and machine learning, robotics and automation, intelligent control, embedded and VLSI systems, communication networks and IoT, power and energy systems, photonics, biomedical technologies, signal and image processing, secure software systems, intelligent sensing, and smart mobility, with emphasis on interdisciplinary research and real-world impact aligned with IEEE’s mission
